statement: Pinned BlueZ's BLE HID-over-GATT profile uses its UHID device path to expose a Bluetooth-bus HID interface to the kernel after service discovery and bonding; this is a host-consumer route and does not demonstrate actual Bluetooth pairing or real-radio transmission from a virtualgamepad UHID instance.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.scope: Existing pinned BlueZ sources are reused; UHID bus 5 is the Linux Bluetooth HID bus. The assertion is about BlueZ and UHID behavior, not a tested Xbox Series device.
